ctl2c_mom_solver_sphere_in_uniform_field.note: mu_r=3 is the asserted case; a voxelised sphere's demagnetising factor differs from 1/3 by about 1.5 %, which is amplified at large mu_r (mu_r=10 shown for information)

ctl4_torque_force_cross_check.tolerance: ratio within 0.9..1.1 (direct route: rim blocks as 27 point dipoles, sensing magnet as 9x9x5 grid)

convergence.criterion: control 3: halving prod -> fine changes the peak total angle error (linear mu_r=1000) by < 10%. The ring-attributable part of that error is reported separately and is converged more slowly (thin high-permeability plate, piecewise-uniform magnetisation)
convergence.saturating_fine_mesh: not run (cost); saturating coarse -> production change is in `relative_change_on_halving.nl`

criteria_stated_before_results.P1: ring-attributable calibrated residual D <= 0.10 deg (cold calibration harm4, validated on non-fit angles and all other conditions, every material variant incl. soft/hard curves and Hc=400 A/m hysteresis, sensor drift corrected as in ui_calcs)
criteria_stated_before_results.P2: absolute calibrated residual R of the worst as-built unit with the ring <= 0.60 deg (the whole pool)
criteria_stated_before_results.P3: |B| at the die stays inside 80 % of the +/-100 mT range with the ui_calcs tolerances (<= 80 mT) and the ring changes |B| by < 1 %
criteria_stated_before_results.P4: all controls pass (ui_calcs 55.7 mT within 2 %, analytic cases within 1 %, convergence < 10 % on halving)
criteria_stated_before_results.derivation: ui_calcs/U24: 1.0 deg absolute budget minus the 0.40 deg non-repeatable error (3.5 sigma noise + stray field + quantisation + 0.057 deg gain residual) leaves 0.60 deg for calibration residual, magnet and mechanism. ui_calcs allocates nothing of it. Equal thirds give 0.20 deg to the mechanism; the ring is one mechanism part, so it may use half of that third: 0.10 deg.
criteria_stated_before_results.inconclusive_if: D is within a factor 2 of the share (the B-H curve and the coil/standoff/mount details are not measured)

clearance_requirement.basis: ring outer 27.5 + 1.5 mm for ring position tolerance, adhesive fillet and assembly

current_J9.face_assumed: tab rear face (see README: a SM10B-SRSS-TB cannot fit in the 1.78 mm front-face gap; datasheet height not fetched)

group_descriptions.A: ideal coaxial unit (C24-symmetric; sweep one 15 deg pitch, tile to the full turn)
group_descriptions.B: worst-tolerance as-built unit: knob offset (0.1, 0.1) mm, tilt 1 deg about u, ring offset (0.1, 0) mm, then the conditions of group A on top
group_descriptions.C: single tolerances, one at a time, released and cold (uncalibrated drift only)

with_ui_calcs_tolerances.basis: Br +/-5 %, -40 C (+2.1 %) as in ui_calcs magnet_field; the study cases are 20 and 176 C only

steel.knee_note: B of the representative curve at H=400 A/m is 1.0 T, 1.5 T at 1500 A/m, 1.9 T at 12 kA/m

sensor_model.offset_drift: not modelled (no sourced number); the cold calibration fits a static offset

inputs.steel_curve_status: representative handbook-typical 1010 anhysteretic curve, NOT a measured curve; soft/hard family = H axis x2 / x0.5; hot: H axis x1.3, J_s x0.97 [ASSUMED]

refinement_at_extrema.note: re-solved around the three largest |ring-attributable error| extrema; peaks at 0.25, 0.0625, 0.03125 deg spacing

A_cold_nl_ring_attributable.note: ideal coaxial unit; any 24th harmonic is the saturation-induced sin(24 theta) term; linear materials give exactly zero

axial_pull.note: central finite difference of the angle-averaged W over gap error -0.2..+0.2 mm; negative = pulls the knob toward the ring; includes the sensing magnet's own pull; a stationary-fixture measurement is still needed for the feel target

detent_torque.note: torque = -dW/dtheta of the induced-steel interaction energy -mu0/2 sum V M.H_ext (exact for linear steel; for the saturating curve it is an estimate, no hysteresis loss included)

tolerance_extended.basis: Br +/-5 %, -40 C (+2.1 %) as in ui_calcs magnet_field; the study cases are 20 and 176 C only

notched_ring_probe.meaning: ring with the pitches that contain the three present standoff directions (0, 158, 202 deg) removed, released, cold, ideal coaxial unit

saturation_summary.knee_note: B of the representative curve at H=400 A/m is 1.0 T, 1.5 T at 1500 A/m, 1.9 T at 12 kA/m

sensor_drift_uncorrected_harm4.note: X/Y sensitivity mismatch drift left uncorrected: a sensor term that is present with or without the ring; D is unaffected

totals_with_coil_allowance.basis: ring D (mesh-adjusted, all variants) and ring D without hysteresis, added to the existing worst-case stray-field allowance (ui_calcs stray_field, no ring in that calculation)
